title: New LV overhead service connection, Penrith NSW

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Righto, let's do the pre-job brief before we get stuck in. Job today is a new LV service connection at 14 Banksia Street, Penrith. Work order 4471823.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Yep, got the paperwork here. It's a new overhead service from the pole out the front to the house, the sparky's already done the meter box.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: So we're working on live LV at the pole. The mains are energised, four fifteen volts, we're not getting an outage for one service.
lines.asr_hypothesis: So we're working on live L V at the pole. The mains are energised, four fifteen volts, we're not getting an outage for one service.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Righto. So arc flash suits on, the rated gloves and the face shield, and we keep everyone well back from under the pole.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Yep. I'll be up in the EWP, you're my safety observer on the ground the whole time.
lines.asr_hypothesis: Yep. I'll be up in the EWB, you're my safety observer on the ground the whole time.

lines.speaker: Guest-3
lines.text: Sorry mate, how long's the power going to be off? I've got the kids home sick.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Shouldn't be off at all for you, we'll be out of your hair by lunch.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Working at heights in the bucket, so harness on and clipped in before you go up, and I'll check the EWP pre-start's been done.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Done it this morning at the depot, all good. Outriggers go on pads, the nature strip's soft after all the rain.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Yeah it's soggy, so we'll put the big pads down.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Traffic's quiet, it's a cul-de-sac, so just cones and a sign either side of the truck. No traffic controllers needed.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: There's no trees anywhere near the service run either, so no vegetation to worry about.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Manual handling, the service cable drum's heavy, so two-person lift or use the drum stand.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Did you watch the Panthers on Saturday? Unreal second half.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Don't start, I lost fifty bucks on that game.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Okay, emergency. Muster point is the corner of Banksia and Wattle, by the post box.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Nearest hospital's Nepean, about ten minutes up Derby Street.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: I'm first aider today, kit's in the truck behind the passenger seat. Comms is mobile, and the radio on channel six to the depot.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Weather's fine, bit of wind this arvo but nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Alright, sign on and let's get into it.
